verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management product, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing about an uptime SLA, a status page, or incident reporting. The items cover API, pricing features, and integrations, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
